name: Smol Birb
source:
Take time to travel along with Zyablik, a small bird who is desperately searching for missing stars.
Will you be kind to everyone who meet along the way or ignore them and their wishes? It`s up to you!

[From [url=https://sonmoss.itch.io/smol-birb]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
花点时间与Zyablik一起旅行，Zyablik是一只拼命寻找失踪星星的小鸟。
你会善待沿途遇到的每个人，还是忽视他们和他们的愿望？由你决定！

[来自[url=https://sonmoss.itch.io/smol-birb]itch.io[/url]]
